name: echochaos
description: EchoChaos — browser-based voice mimicry party game (monorepo root)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix frontend
